text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1001, Large Butterfly Door Knocker

This Large Butterfly Door Knocker measures 7-1/4 inches tall and 7 inches wide. In many cultures, the butterfly is symbolic of powerful transformations and this Brass and Bronze Butterfly Door Knocker will be sure to transform your door into a work of art. The Butterfly Front Door Knocker by Michael Healy Designs is finished in brass and bronze, a look that is achieved by changing the amounts of copper content in the alloy.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Butterfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Satin Bronze
  • Height: 7-1/4"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-13/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
